description: Authorizes an AWS IAM role against a Cloud Provider Access role registration so Atlas can assume it. Use MongoDB::Atlas::CloudProviderAccessSetup to register the role first, then use this resource to authorize it. Deleting this resource removes the whole Cloud Provider Access role registration, not only the authorization.

FeatureUsage.description: MongoDB Cloud feature associated with the authorized AWS IAM role.

FeatureType.description: Human-readable label that describes one MongoDB Cloud feature linked to this AWS IAM role.

FeatureUsageId.description: Identifying characteristics about the AWS Simple Storage Service (S3) export bucket linked to this AWS IAM role.

GroupId.description: Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies your project.

BucketName.description: Name of the AWS S3 bucket to which your logs are exported.

Profile.description: The profile is defined in AWS Secret manager. See [Secret Manager Profile setup](../../../examples/profile-secret.yaml).

ProjectId.description: Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies your project.

RoleId.description: Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the Cloud Provider Access role registration to authorize. This is the RoleId returned by MongoDB::Atlas::CloudProviderAccessSetup.

IamAssumedRoleArn.description: Amazon Resource Name (ARN) that identifies the AWS IAM role that MongoDB Cloud assumes when it accesses resources in your AWS account. Changing this value re-authorizes the same Cloud Provider Access role in place.

AuthorizedDate.description: Date and time when the role was authorized for the specified cloud service provider. This parameter expresses its value in the ISO 8601 timestamp format in UTC.

FeatureUsages.description: List of MongoDB Cloud features that use the authorized AWS IAM role.
